work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Chirograph CLV (Latin address LF35106–35107 to Cardinal Mario Mattei, protocol LF35110, salutation LF35111–35112; Italian body; it calls itself presente Nostro chirografo) replaces the Clerks Regular Minor by the Doctrinarian Fathers at Marino, settles legacies, revenues and the town’s endowment of the schools; across running titles LF35137, LF35208, LF35417, LF35511, own provenance LF35205, page numbers LF35280, LF35351, LF35580, LF35649, signature LF35577 and sheet number 31 LF35646; dated Dato dal Nostro palazzo apostolico Vaticano li 12 decembre 1837 (LF35690–35691). Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF35110–35110; the source closing at LF35690–35691 reads: Dato dal Nostro palazzo apostolico Vaticano li 12 decembre 1837. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
